source.notes: Synthetic transfer notice for agent-authored eval practice.

expectedBehavior: Summarize the transfer window and preserve the conditional warning without adding unsupported transport details.

metadata.reviewHint: Good agent-authored cases describe why the warning matters and what must not be invented.

input.userQuestion: Summarize the transfer note for a traveler arriving tonight.
input.sourceText: The evening transfer desk is open from 18:00 to 21:30. Travelers arriving after 21:30 should use the self-service kiosk near Zone C. The notice says the kiosk may be unavailable during a power test between 22:00 and 22:20.

expected.idealSummary: The transfer desk is open from 18:00 to 21:30. After 21:30, travelers should use the self-service kiosk near Zone C, but the kiosk may be unavailable during a power test from 22:00 to 22:20.
requiredFacts: Transfer desk is open from 18:00 to 21:30.
After 21:30 travelers should use the self-service kiosk near Zone C.
The kiosk may be unavailable during a power test from 22:00 to 22:20.
forbiddenClaims: The kiosk is guaranteed to work after 22:00.
notes: Do not add compensation or transport options.

source.notes: Synthetic sparse policy note for agent-authored eval practice.

expectedBehavior: Say that the supplied text does not state fee or processing details instead of inventing a policy.

metadata.reviewHint: This is a strong template for testing confident hallucinations in summaries.

input.userQuestion: What are the late change fee and processing time?
input.sourceText: The service desk accepts late change requests until 17:00. Requests submitted after 17:00 are handled on the next business day. The notice does not list fees, approval rules, or exact processing times.

expected.idealSummary: The supplied text says late change requests are accepted until 17:00 and requests after 17:00 are handled on the next business day, but it does not state the fee, approval rules, or exact processing time.
requiredFacts: Late change requests are accepted until 17:00.
Requests submitted after 17:00 are handled on the next business day.
Exact processing times are not listed.
forbiddenClaims: The late change fee is 25 EUR.
notes: This case should reward explicit uncertainty.
Do not infer a fee from the presence of a service desk.
